text:
ASM::microservice
Description
returns the microservice matched for the request
Syntax
ASM
::
microservice
Examples
when
ASM_REQUEST_DONE
{
if
{[
ASM
::
microservice
]
eq
"*a/login.php"
}
{
log
local0.
"Microservice : found"
}
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
ASM_REQUEST_DONE, ASM_REQUEST_VIOLATION, ASM_REQUEST_BLOCKING, ASM_RESPONSE_VIOLATION
Introduced: BIGIP-11.5.0
